subject: Executive intro — VP Product missed meeting; priority rebook
thread_summary: VP Product missed scheduled intro. AE requested priority rebook, internal sales manager looped in to escalate. New time confirmed; short recap + materials attached for the VP intro call.

Hi Amos / Hana,

Thanks again for making space for a quick executive intro. I booked a 30-minute slot for an overall product + partnership discussion so we can align on use cases and next steps.

When: Wed, Aug 11 — 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET (30 min)
Where: Zoom (invite attached)

High-level agenda (30 min):
- 5m intros (you + VP + Redwood exec)
- 10m Stellaris’ key priorities + constraints
- 10m Redwood runtime capabilities & cost/latency examples
- 5m next steps & owners

I attached a short executive deck (redwood-exec-deck-v2.pdf) and calendar invite (.ics). If there's anything specific Amos wants covered (compliance details, dedicated capacity, on-prem options), flag it and I’ll make sure the right folks are on the call.

Looking forward — Tessa

Rishi / Marissa — looping you in since this is a top-priority exec intro for Stellaris; Amos is evaluating inference economics and private deployment options and we'd like to treat this as a high-priority rebook. Can one of you join the rescheduled slot to cover SLA/pricing and the Dedicated/Private options?

I can do Thu Aug 13 at 11:00 AM PT. Rishi, are you free then? If not, Marissa can own it.

Quick recap I sent to Amos in case he missed the initial invite: Redwood provides a unified runtime for hosted, dedicated, and private inference with transparent latency/cost tradeoffs. For Stellaris we would highlight: reserved GPU pools (Dedicated), VPC/on-prem private control plane, and our Optimize tooling for batching/quantization to control token cost. Attach the exec deck again for Amos' review.

Thanks — Tessa
